rows.title: Rhymetime in Sutton Central Library
rows.description: Our ever popular Rhymetimes are here for children aged 0-5 to enjoy singing and stories with Sutton Council's Cultural Services, the people behind your local libraries and heritage houses. Please book a ticket for each child and adult wanting to attend. Children must be accompanied by a responsible adult throughout. This event may be photographed and/or recorded for marketing and evaluation purposes. If you do not wish to be a part of future promotional material, please make it known at the time of the event. Please log in with your library credentials to reserve your place at this event.
